notes:
Summary: Copper Ridge is evaluating Redwood Dedicated for customer-facing support and reranking workloads. Primary drivers: predictable latency under peak loads, clear throughput guarantees, and strict data residency for EU/NA customers. They already run an internal model-hosting stack but are under pressure to reduce operational overhead and get SLA-backed guarantees for external contracts.

Traffic profile (from infra deep-dive):
- Primary workload: multi-turn support-chat (hybrid retrieval + generation) and reranking for search results.
- Steady-state QPS: ~75 concurrent request/sec during business hours (north-south), with avg response size ~140 tokens.
- Peak events: batch notification spikes and marketing-driven peaks up to ~420 req/sec for short windows (5-20min).
- Avg tokens per second target: planning for ~10k–12k tokens/sec steady, up to 60k tokens/sec short peaks across the allocation.

Latency / SLO targets discussed:
- P50 latency target: <= 100ms for small prompt paths (embeddings & rerank prefetch).
- P95 latency target: <= 450ms for generated chat turns (95th percentile).
- SLO ask from procurement: 99.9% availability and burst scaling guarantee for 15min peaks; legal pushing for SLA credits tied to p95 objective.

Workshop objectives (dedicated sizing):
- Produce baseline GPU pool sizing: model choices + quantization assumptions + expected tokens/sec per GPU SKU.
- Map steady vs peak capacity and autoscaling/burst windows; recommend buffer % for cache warming and KV cache sizing.
- Provide throughput guarantees and suggested SLA language for procurement to review.
- Deliver cost/latency trade-off scenarios (e.g., more GPUs for latency headroom vs lower unit cost with batching).

Notes from calls / quotes: "We need predictable tail latency for enterprise contracts — cannot have degraded search during earnings calls." — Head of Platform.

Technical constraints:
- Data residency: EU customer data must remain in EU region and encrypted-at-rest with customer KMS.
- Integration: currently SSO via Okta; require SAML + SCIM provisioning.
- Telemetry: want token-level cost breakdown and per-route traces for 90-day retention (ops ask).

POC approach proposed: 3-week POC on Redwood Dedicated with a reserved GPU pool sized to handle 2x steady-state and short bursts; run synthetic peak tests (15/20/30 min windows) and real-traffic shadowing for 48 hours. Deliverable: sizing report + SLA draft + cost model.

Immediate next steps: confirm internal infra team availability for workshop (Mar 12), legal to provide redlines on residency and SLA, SE to prepare model perf slides + token/sec estimates (Diego).
notes_short: Enterprise fintech evaluating Dedicated. Needs steady vs peak sizing, SLA for p95 latency, EU residency + KMS. Workshop scheduled 2026-03-12. POC proposal: 3-week reserved GPU POC + synthetic peak tests.
